_about: The English strings: the defaults. Every other language's file has exactly these keys and these placeholders (tests/test_mp_strings.cpp), and a table that lacks a key shows this one.

Each value equals the English the rules fields still hold (the drift case of tests/test_mp_strings.cpp): hud.part is ui.json's caption and pause title prefix 'Part ' with the level number; dashboard.chapter is the dashboard's 'Chapter ' prefix;

dashboard.new is the dashboard's new_label text; selector.requires is the selector's warning words with the chapter_unlock_percent of ui.json's locking block as {percent}; card.unlocked is achievements.json's card message_prefix with the title;

card.locked_level is achievements.json's locked_card message; the secret achievement's two texts are NOT here: they are Asantee's words and live in the gitignored out/data/achievements.<code>.json (Achievements::LoadTranslation); credits.* are the words of ui.json's credits tail;
options.* are the words of controls.json's options block; hint.camera is camera.json's hint text; language.title is this port's own. The numbers these strings carry are never stored here.

strings.credits.enhanced: an enhanced version of Magic Portals by Asantee Games
strings.credits.engine: the enhanced version and the Supersonic Engine
